elements.text:
You're the only one in your friend group who hasn't had your first kiss. When your friends talk about their experiecnes, you feel embarassed and left out

Here are some thoughts that might pop into mind:

texts: Even if my first kiss happens later than other people's, it doesn't mean anything is wrong with me.
Everyone reaches these milestones at their own pace, and timing doesn't reflect my worth or likability.
Something must be fundamentally wrong with me if everyone else has reached this milestone and I haven't.
I keep telling myself I'll never catch up, but I know that's anxiety talking rather than reality.
When it does happen for me, it will feel meaningful rather than rushed.
